of guar gum. Guar as a plant has a multitude of diff erent 
functions for human and animal nutrition but its gelling 
agent containing seeds (guar gum) is today the most useful.

gum in hydraulic fracturing (oil shale gas). About 80% of 
world production occurs in India and Pakistan.
